{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gods of Age''' were a group of seventeen [[Deity/Legends|deities]] that were worshipped by the [[Fian/Legends|Fia]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galantos]]. Each deity represented a different stage in the Fia life cycle and each Fian worshipped the deity that corresponded with their particular age group. The god [[Hus'yoyu]] represented Fia from birth to the age of six, while the god [[Gotagei]] was assigned to Fia that reached the age of forty, and the god [[Erio'anum]] was prayed to by the Fia from the age of ninety-seven until [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
